spec: §11: "Specificity is the lexicographic tuple (path length, number of non-* iterations, step non-*, phase non-*, generated non-*)"; "document order is never significant"
derivation: §11 explicitly defines a lexicographic tuple. For matching entries with (1,1,0,0,0) and (1,0,1,0,0), the first wins at the second component, 1>0. Reversing document order cannot change the winner. The old fixture incorrectly treated the order componentwise; no incomparable pair exists between these two lexicographic tuples.
